title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2611.19179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.

translated_title: 遮挡诱导部分可观测性下多视角规划中的感知隔离
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视觉规划基准测试中的表现开始趋于饱和，然而在遮挡诱导的部分可观测性（PO）条件下，它们无法解决深度歧义问题，且性能随问题规模增大而急剧下降。我们基于Blocksworld领域提出了BW-PO，这是一个受控基准，能将现有VLM规划器和形式化工具的性能降至接近于零；同时我们提出VLM-as-perceiver（VLM作为感知器）范式，将VLM的角色局限于局部感知，而将跨视角证据的协调与规划生成委托给外部求解器。在BW-PO的各个模型特定挑战性子集上，该方法将Gemma-4-31B的规划成功率从1%提升至97%，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B从0%提升至95%，Gemini-3.1-Pro从3%提升至84%。通过这种感知隔离方式，我们将原本相互纠缠的两个瓶颈分离开来：深度歧义下的证据协调，以及场景密度下的视觉提取完整性。
tldr: 提出VLM-as-perceiver范式，将VLM的角色局限于局部感知，把跨视角证据协调与规划生成委托给外部求解器，在遮挡部分可观测性基准BW-PO上将多个VLM的规划成功率从接近于零大幅提升至84%-97%。
en_tdlr: Proposes VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that confines VLMs to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers, boosting plan success rates on the occlusion-induced partial observability benchmark BW-PO from near-zero to 84-97%.
